claims.claim: Brain Sync implements bounded deterministic planning projection with a unique NEXT proof or explicit conflict. Unique unauthored NEXT resolves to TASK_AUTHORING without fabricating TASK or Unified State.
Relevance compilation uses closed versioned Flow Card, lifecycle, subject, blocker and request inputs through deterministic rules, without model ranking, embeddings or semantic retrieval.
Projection and budget handling retain exact control facts; competing NEXT mirrors and oversized non-elidable controls fail closed.
Elision uses closed versioned rules with bounded class, rule, selector and source-digest provenance. Unknown or ambiguous elision rules are rejected.

Disposable reuse binds current source identities, digests, selectors, Flow Cards and pipeline versions, and checks cached content digests. Retained regressions assert binding invalidation and semantic equivalence after cache deletion.

Deterministic UTF-8 budgeting follows projection, elision and reuse. Supporting detail alone receives bounded overflow summaries; exact controls remain intact, and decision dependencies require fresh digest-bound exact expansion.

BrainWorkContext and Flow Card resolution consume compiled bounded observations. Historical expansion requires explicit bounded dependencies; composition and resolution retain observation-only authority.

Retained regressions cover split brain, unauthored NEXT, binding movement, cache deletion, overflow, exact expansion, control facts and malformed relevance inputs. The reserved pytest argument was renamed to request_value without changing cases or assertions.

CANONICAL_CONTEXT_PIPELINE_V1 and its three compatibility exits remain declared. The committed repair changes only tests/test_brain_context.py; production and Brain Sync regression bytes remain identical to the failed candidate, preserving existing authority boundaries.
